title: Zephyrine and the Protocol
author: Rosalind Iversen
blurb: Edmund Delacroix, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
